name: Dana Whitfield
shortBio: Former RevOps lead who has deployed automation stacks at three B2B SaaS companies from Series A through IPO.
bio: Dana spent nine years running revenue operations at B2B SaaS companies, most recently as Director of RevOps at a Series D data infrastructure vendor where she owned a 40-tool stack and a $1.2M annual software budget. She has personally built and maintained more than 300 production integrations across Zapier, Make, Workato and custom middleware, and now leads StackPipeline's hands-on testing program. Dana writes about integration architecture, data hygiene and the operational cost of tool sprawl.

name: Marcus Oyelaran
shortBio: Backend engineer specialising in API integration design, webhook reliability and data pipeline observability.
bio: Marcus is a backend engineer with eleven years of experience building data pipelines and API integrations for companies in fintech and logistics. He has shipped production connectors against more than 80 third-party APIs, written the retry and idempotency layer behind a platform processing 12 million webhook events per day, and contributes to several open-source n8n community nodes. At StackPipeline, Marcus stress-tests every integration path we document — including the failure modes vendors leave out of their own docs.
credentials: 11 years in backend and integration engineering

name: Priya Raghunathan
shortBio: Ten-year B2B technology journalist who runs StackPipeline's review cycle and pricing verification process.
bio: Priya has covered enterprise software for a decade, previously as a senior editor at a B2B technology publication where she oversaw software review standards and vendor disclosure policy. She built StackPipeline's editorial review loop: every published page is re-verified against live vendor pricing pages and product documentation on a fixed 90-day cycle, and every affiliate relationship is disclosed before a score is assigned. Priya fact-checks all comparison and review content on the site.
credentials: Former senior editor, B2B technology desk
